categories.main_business_segments: TSMC primarily operates as a dedicated semiconductor foundry, providing integrated circuit manufacturing services. Its business segments include advanced logic process technologies (2nm, 3nm, 4nm, 5nm, 7nm, and mature nodes), specialty process technologies (RF, embedded memory, power management, sensors), advanced packaging and 3D silicon stacking (TSMC 3DFabricTM), and design ecosystem support including IP and EDA tools. The company also engages in wafer fabrication, mask making, and testing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: TSMC's core technologies include advanced CMOS logic process nodes down to 2nm using nanosheet transistor structures, FinFET technologies from 3nm to 7nm, and specialty processes such as embedded flash, MRAM, RRAM, RF, and BCD. It integrates advanced packaging technologies like CoWoS®, InFO, and TSMC-SoIC® for 3DIC solutions. The company employs cutting-edge lithography including EUV, advanced mask technologies, and extensive R&D in materials, device physics, and process integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: TSMC serves a global customer base of over 500 clients, including fabless semiconductor companies, system companies, and integrated device manufacturers. Key end markets include high-performance computing (HPC), smartphones, Internet of Things (IoT), automotive electronics, and consumer electronics. Major customers include AMD, Apple, Broadcom, Intel, MediaTek, NVIDIA, Qualcomm, Sony Semiconductor, and others.
categories.geographic_coverage: TSMC operates manufacturing facilities primarily in Taiwan, with major fabs in Hsinchu, Taichung, and Tainan Science Parks. It is expanding production capacity in the United States (Arizona) and Japan (Kumamoto). The company has sales and support offices in North America, Europe, Japan, China, and South Korea, serving a worldwide customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: TSMC operates as a leading upstream semiconductor foundry in the supply chain, providing wafer fabrication services to fabless and IDM customers. It does not design or sell its own branded products, focusing exclusively on manufacturing and related services. It plays a critical role in the semiconductor ecosystem by enabling chip design companies to outsource manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: TSMC's strategic focus is on maintaining technology leadership through continuous R&D investment, especially in advanced nodes like 2nm and 3nm, and expanding 3DIC and advanced packaging technologies. The company emphasizes energy-efficient computing, system integration, and specialty processes to meet emerging market demands. It also invests in digital transformation, AI-driven manufacturing, and sustainability initiatives including green manufacturing and supply chain responsibility.
categories.revenue_model: TSMC generates revenue primarily through wafer sales based on foundry manufacturing services. It charges customers for wafer fabrication, mask making, testing, and packaging services. Revenue is derived from volume shipments of wafers across various process nodes and technologies, with pricing reflecting technology complexity and capacity utilization.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: TSMC is the global leader in semiconductor foundry services, holding approximately 30% of the global semiconductor market (excluding memory). Its main competitors include Samsung Foundry, GlobalFoundries, UMC, and SMIC. TSMC differentiates itself through advanced technology leadership, manufacturing excellence, and strong customer trust, maintaining a dominant position in advanced process technologies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: TSMC is a large-cap company with consolidated revenues of approximately NT$2.26 trillion (about US$75.9 billion) in 2022, representing a 43% increase year-over-year. Net income reached over NT$1 trillion, with EPS of NT$39.20, a 70% increase from the prior year. The company has sustained 13 consecutive years of record revenues and strong profitability, with significant capital expenditures exceeding NT$1 trillion annually to expand capacity and technology.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TSMC's value proposition centers on delivering industry-leading advanced semiconductor manufacturing technologies with superior performance, power efficiency, and yield. Its comprehensive technology platforms, including advanced nodes and 3D packaging, enable customers to innovate and accelerate time-to-market. TSMC's commitment to customer trust, confidentiality, flexible global manufacturing footprint, and sustainability further differentiate it from competitors.
